summary: Listener facts were extracted for the explicit selector and summarized compactly.
Handler source metadata included URL/line/column/function name for the selected listener.
Compact node-to-handler chain evidence stayed bounded and did not claim full taint tracking.
diagnostics: The flow remained selector-scoped and artifact-first.
Selector miss/invalid cases must recover by narrowing the selector rather than broad DOM crawling.

notes: This workflow extends existing browser_hook/browser_artifact evidence paths instead of introducing a new public DOM-flow tool.
The result is evidence assistance only, not a full dynamic taint engine or exploit-decider.
